memories.author: D03
memories.text: PRESENTING COMPLAINT: Routine review of obesity and chronic kidney disease in a 79‑year‑old postal worker. EXAMINATION: BP 148/86 mmHg, weight 78 kg, height 1.55 m, BMI 32.5 (obese). Abdomen soft, no edema. IMPRESSION: 1. Obesity, BMI >25. 2. CKD stage G3a, eGFR ~48 mL/min/1.73m2. ARRANGEMENTS: Start orlistat 120 mg with each main meal, telmisartan 40 mg OD, dapagliflozin 10 mg OD, furosemide 20 mg OD, sodium bicarbonate 500 mg BD. Order fasting lipid profile, fasting glucose, HbA1c, LFT, serum creatinine, eGFR, urine ACR, Hb. Return if chest pain, breathlessness, fever >39°C, or bloody stools.

memories.author: D03
memories.text: PRESENTING COMPLAINT: Follow‑up for obesity and CKD; reports mild ankle swelling. EXAMINATION: BP 142/80 mmHg, weight 77.5 kg, BMI 32.2 (obese). Mild pitting edema ankles. IMPRESSION: 1. Obesity stable. 2. CKD G3a, slight fluid retention. ARRANGEMENTS: Increase telmisartan to 80 mg OD. Continue other meds. Advise low‑salt diet, elevate legs. Return if worsening edema, shortness of breath, or sudden weight gain.

memories.author: D03
memories.text: PRESENTING COMPLAINT: Routine review; patient reports reduced swelling after telmisartan increase. EXAMINATION: BP 138/78 mmHg, weight 77 kg, BMI 32.0 (obese). No edema. IMPRESSION: 1. Obesity, BMI still >25. 2. CKD G3a, improved fluid status. ARRANGEMENTS: Continue orlistat, telmisartan 80 mg OD, dapagliflozin, furosemide, sodium bicarbonate. Order fasting lipid profile, glucose, HbA1c, LFT, renal panel. Return if chest pain, dyspnoea, fever >39°C, or gastrointestinal bleeding.

memories.author: D03
memories.text: PRESENTING COMPLAINT: 6‑month review; patient mentions occasional heartburn after meals. EXAMINATION: BP 140/82 mmHg, weight 76.5 kg, BMI 31.9 (obese). Abdomen soft, no tenderness. IMPRESSION: 1. Obesity, persistent. 2. CKD G3a, stable. 3. Possible mild gastritis. ARRANGEMENTS: Stop sodium bicarbonate due to risk of metabolic alkalosis; continue other meds. Advise smaller meals, avoid lying down after eating. Order renal function labs. Return if vomiting, melena, or severe epigastric pain.

memories.author: D03
memories.text: Referral to Nephrology, Bangalore General Hospital. Reason: CKD stage G3a with persistent proteinuria (ACR 35 mg/g) despite maximal tolerated ACEi/ARB and SGLT2i; need specialist opinion on further management and possible investigation for underlying glomerulopathy.

memories.author: D03
memories.text: Nephrology review: CKD likely hypertensive etiology; proteinuria moderate. Continue telmisartan and dapagliflozin, add low‑dose spironolactone 12.5 mg OD if potassium permits. Repeat labs in 3 months. No urgent intervention required.
